dex.entry: A radiant crystal-stag whose antlers are grown entirely from pure luminous diamond crystal; it illuminates entire mine chambers as it walks, and its light is said to repel the Hollowing. The crystal-antlered stag lighting the dark mine — majestic and mysterious, every player wants to find it.

art.silhouette: Elegant deer-like kin with a white-grey crystal body; antlers are an elaborate branching structure of cyan-diamond crystal that glow continuously; eyes are large and clear as water; hooves are polished white stone; beautiful and otherworldly.
